notes.title: BIG UPDATE
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36385735/32abf6d055a1324af83144413c2fe48d7520a8ac.png[/img]Hello everyone,

In this update I create new characters to Police and Terrorist and now if you play on one site you have special character skin. New map Prison is added to game with nice optimalization. New movement about sprint is ready on characters. Completely optimalized all maps and this is not end about FLAGFIGHTS. There is still a long way to go.

notes.title: UPDATE 0.13
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Today i upload new map INDUSTRIAL ZONE with TDM mod. Bunker map has been modified and I repaired bugs in walls. Menu is repaired and have new wallpaper. On main menu I still working. Animations on walking is modified and now I working on sounds that are missing from some weapons. 

Thanks all to support
TomasKGames

notes.title: UPDATE 0.12
notes.content: In this update, the GalaxyStation map has been modified and objects have been added to all maps. Map Bunker has been expanded to include additional rooms. Recoil system was modified for weapons VICTOR, KA, EM4. Instructions about game has been added to the main menu. Hitbox system is updated, with sniper rifles and shotgun 100% kill to the body.

notes.content:
